title.zh: Cairn 如何找回项目决定

subtitle.zh: 普通召回：先用现有 Context，再找候选，最后查原文。
subtitle.en: Ordinary recall moves from current context to candidates to source.

lines.zh: 已在当前任务中的信息
按项目和线程保留短期候选
按字面匹配，复用前检查快照
lines.en: Match literal terms; check before reuse.

lines.zh: 唯一事实来源，保留决定原文和历史
lines.en: Source of truth for decisions and history.

lines.zh: 按 ID 查原文，按协议变更决定
lines.en: Read by ID; change through the Protocol.

bypass.zh: 已知 ID、决定变更或高影响核对：直接查 L3
bypass.en: Known ID, lifecycle change, or high-impact check: go directly to L3

invalidation.zh: 项目决定变化 → 丢弃旧简报，按需重建
invalidation.en: Project decisions change → discard the old brief and rebuild as needed

caption.zh: 机制示意 · Cairn 不保存简报
caption.en: Mechanism diagram · Cairn does not store the brief
